title: Holidays to Test AI Shopping Bots From Google, Amazon, Meta and OpenAI
description: Google, Amazon, Meta and OpenAI all want to help pick your holiday gifts. Whose advice will shoppers take?

title: Musk Says He’ll Give US Children Another SpaceX Share Every Year
description: Elon Musk and SpaceX will give every child in the US another share in the space exploration company every year, according to a post on X from the world’s richest man.

title: TDK Bets on AI Data Centers and Robots to Fuel Sensor Growth
description: TDK Corp. is preparing to boost production of its high-end magnetic sensors, seeking to capitalize on widening use of the components in cars, humanoid robots and AI data centers.
